# Original-volume rows: exact centroid defect and logarithmic reserve

This is an exact consequence of the actual full-space transport in `candidate 3b257d8ddacb6167`. It retains its actual continuous target allocations. It does not identify parameter weights with physical response weights or establish a Gamma payment.

## 1. Two probability laws on the same actual row

Use the source's notation: original mixed measure dm, total mass M, positive finite-plane parameter L with mean(log L)=0, actual proper marks Y_i, positive sigma_i summing to one, L_i=L(Y_i), and allocations q_i whose sum is one. Let

    nu=dm/(M L),   m_i=sigma_i/L_i,
    rho_i=q_i nu/m_i,             bar_rho_i=q_i dm/(M sigma_i).

Both are probability measures. The established row identities give

    E_(rho_i) w=Y_i,       E_(rho_i) L=L_i,
    d bar_rho_i/d rho_i=L/L_i.                         (1)

In particular the original uniform mixed probability measure decomposes exactly as

    dm/M=sum_i sigma_i bar_rho_i.                      (2)

Every original row is an actual subdensity q_i of original volume, rescaled by its own mass. It is generally not uniform on a convex set or on a complete target fiber.

Choose any affine source majorant A_i active at Y_i. The contact theorem gives L=A_i rho_i-a.e. Write its full-space gradient as a_i, so

    L(w)=L_i+a_i.(w-Y_i)   rho_i-a.e.                   (3)

All statements are relative to the actual affine ambient span.

## 2. Exact covariance displacement

Let C_i=Cov_(rho_i)(w) and bar_Y_i=E_(bar_rho_i) w. Multiplying (3) by w-Y_i and using (1) gives

    bar_Y_i-Y_i=C_i a_i/L_i,                           (4)
    a_i.(bar_Y_i-Y_i)=Var_(rho_i)(L)/L_i>=0.            (5)

The expression C_i a_i is independent of the chosen active plane. Indeed the difference of two active planes vanishes on the row, so its linear part annihilates every centered row vector almost surely.

Consequently the following are equivalent for a row:

    bar_Y_i=Y_i;
    Var_(rho_i)(L)=0;
    L=L_i rho_i-a.e.;
    bar_rho_i=rho_i.                                   (6)

The forward implication uses (5); the reverse ones are immediate. Thus recovering the original-volume source mean is exactly a constant-parameter condition on the actual row, not an automatic consequence of the tilted martingale.

The continuous part of (4) also retains the base/continuous cross covariance. Writing a_i=(b_i,c_i) and C_i in blocks gives

    bar_y_i-y_i=(C_i^(Xz)b_i+C_i^(XX)c_i)/L_i.          (7)

The same-gradient label theorem controls c_i, but does not remove the mixed term or force either term to vanish. This is an explicit obstruction to silently replacing the tilted continuous mean by the original one.

## 3. Exact entropy reserve

The relative entropy of the two actual row laws is finite because L is bounded above and below on compact C. Equation (1) yields

    D_i=KL(bar_rho_i || rho_i)
       =E_(bar_rho_i) log(L/L_i)>=0.                   (8)

Combining (2), the original logarithmic normalization, and sum sigma=1 gives the exact identity

    -sum_i sigma_i log L_i=sum_i sigma_i D_i>=0.        (9)

Equality holds precisely when every positive row satisfies the equivalent conditions (6). This supplies a genuine nonnegative reserve measured on the actual target laws. It is not a physical cap-loss inequality.

For explicit quantitative bounds let l_i and U_i be the essential infimum and supremum of L on the row. The function s log s has second derivative 1/s. Taylor comparison at s=1 and E_(rho_i)(L/L_i)=1 therefore gives

    Var_(rho_i)(L)/(2 L_i U_i)
       <=D_i<=Var_(rho_i)(L)/(2 L_i l_i).               (10)

This includes the constant case by direct continuity. Equations (5) and (10) also express the entropy reserve in terms of the actual mean displacement in the active-plane direction.

If the unique continuous gradient c_i of a row is nonzero, then D_i>0. Otherwise equality would confine that positive row to the affine level {A_i=L_i}; this has zero d-volume in every sampled fiber and is incompatible with absolute continuity. Hence a nonzero target gradient label forces strictness in (9). The converse is not asserted: a zero continuous gradient can still vary with the base along a row.

## 4. What the identities do and do not supply

The exact original full centroid decomposes as

    g_original=sum_i sigma_i Y_i
                  +sum_i (sigma_i/L_i) C_i a_i.         (11)

This is the full mean defect left after the original-mass label identity. Its summands retain the actual allocations and supporting planes. Only their projections onto their own a_i are nonnegative; they do not share a common signed direction in general.

The one-label example in `candidate 7738d044742e9b61` has L=1, so ALL of (4), (5), and (9) have equality, and its original row is already the uniform mixed measure with the actual deepest mean. Nevertheless its class Gamma payment fails. Therefore even exact zero mean defect and zero entropy reserve, added to the audited full-space transport and parameter optimality, do not settle the class budget. A new use of joint body minimality must constrain actual cap/shape responses; no replacement of those responses by the present volume identities is justified.
